newsitem.title: USA: AccelGraphics sees weak Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: AccelGraphics sees weak Q2 results.

text.p: AccelGraphics Inc said Wednesday it expects earnings per share for its second quarter to be between $0.04 and $0.05, below analysts' expectations.

Analysts had expected the company to earn $0.12 a share for the second quarter, ended June 30, according to First Call. The company, which recent went public had earnings or $0.12 a share in the first quarter. It had an undisclosed net loss in the year-ago second quarter.
The company said in a statement that preliminary results showed revenues for the second quarter at about $9.75 million to $10.5 million compared to $3.1 million in the year-ago second quarter.

The company said the weaker results were due to slower international sales due to softness, competitive pricing pressures and lower than expected demand for new products as well as lower orders than previously expected from one major original equipment manufacturer.
